title: Donut Summary Metric Value & Label Calibrated Responsive Sizing

complexity.rationale: S/M/L target font sizes are now confirmed exact (not approximated) via the donut-chart-tokens skill, so that part of the research is done. What's still open is a real design decision: the current holeRatio-based sizing model is structurally incompatible with the design's fixed-px-ring-width-per-tier system, and the two documented 'derived' (unconfirmed) XS/XL values plus the between-tier visibility boundary still need resolving before the new implementation can be finalized.

summary: The Donut Summary (metric value + metric label centered in the donut) currently sizes its text using a placeholder ratio (donutRadius * holeRatio * a fixed ratio constant) snapped through a generic threshold scale. The donut-chart-tokens skill documents the actual S2 design system for this: five named size tiers (XS/S/M/L/XL, fixed outer diameters) each with an exact, independently-specified metric-value and metric-label font size, and a ring (hole) width that is a fixed px value per tier rather than a ratio of the outer diameter. Confirmed with the user: which lines are shown (value, label, and the separately-tracked delta line in donut-summary-delta-line) is controlled by which optional props are supplied, not by the donut's size tier - every size tier can show any combination of lines. The current implementation needs to be replaced with font sizing keyed directly to these named tiers instead of the placeholder ratio formula; the existing visibility cutoff should remain a fit-based fallback (hide text that's too small to render legibly/without overlap) rather than a deliberate per-tier design rule.
requirements: Metric value ('metric total') font size must follow the exact per-size-tier px values confirmed in Figma's component-set variants: S (120px diameter) = 20px, M (160px) = 22px, L (200px) = 36px - all fontWeight 800, color gray-800/text-primary.
Metric label font size must follow the exact per-size-tier px values confirmed in Figma: S (120px) = 14px, M (160px) = 16px, L (200px) = 20px - all fontWeight 700, color gray-800/text-primary.

XS (60px diameter) and XL (400px diameter) use the donut-chart-tokens skill's derived values (metric total 18px/50px, metric label 12px/24px) as a starting point, but these are explicitly flagged in that skill as computed-not-measured and must be confirmed in Figma before being treated as final.

Font size must be keyed directly to the donut's outer diameter (the chart.donut.size.* breakpoints: 60/120/160/200/400px), not derived through the existing holeRatio-based ratio formula - ring width is a fixed px-per-tier value (16/18/20/22/24px) that scales at a different rate than the outer diameter, so a single ratio constant cannot reproduce both the ring width and the font-size ramp correctly at every tier.

Which lines render (value, label) is controlled by the props supplied (e.g. hideValue, whether a label is passed) at every size tier - not gated by the donut's size. The existing MIN_RADIUS-style cutoff should remain only as a fit-based fallback (hiding text that would be illegibly small or overlap the arc), recalibrated to the corrected fixed-ring-width model, not reworked into a per-tier visibility rule.

Long metric label text must continue to truncate (ellipsis) within the donut's inner hole radius at every size tier - the inner radius itself must be computed from the corrected fixed-ring-width model (outer radius minus the tier's ring width), not the current holeRatio-derived radius.

designTokens.usage: Outer donut diameter per named size tier. Only S/M/L are true Figma component-set variants ('Donut (S)/(M)/(L)'); XS/XL are scaled instances, not their own variant sets.

Fixed px ring (donut hole) width per size tier - NOT a ratio of the outer diameter; there is no hole-ratio design token. Diameter and ring width scale at different rates (120->160->200 vs 18->20->22), so one cannot be derived from the other.
Font size for the metric value text centered in the donut hole, keyed directly to the size tier's outer diameter.
Font size for the metric label text centered in the donut hole, keyed directly to the size tier's outer diameter.

edgeCases.case: XS size tier (60px diameter) with a label supplied
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The label still renders if it fits (per the fit-based MIN_RADIUS-style cutoff) - XS is not a hard suppression of labels by design, just the tier where they're least likely to fit legibly.

edgeCases.case: Donut diameter between named tiers (e.g. the ~106px Figma example used earlier in this investigation, between XS=60 and S=120)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Confirm the expected font-size interpolation behavior since this isn't a named tier - whether RSC snaps to the nearest tier's font size or interpolates continuously between them.
Confirm whether font size continues to scale past 50px/24px or caps at the XL values.
Truncates with an ellipsis inside the corrected (fixed-ring-width-based) inner radius at every size tier, not overflowing the hole or overlapping the arc.
Label sizing still follows the corrected per-tier font size; the existing hideValue font-size-multiplier logic continues to apply on top of the corrected base size.
The boolean/percent summary value uses the same corrected per-tier sizing as the standard aggregated sum value.

edgeCases.case: User-supplied custom holeRatio (not matching any named size tier)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Confirm how the public holeRatio prop should interact with the new fixed-ring-width-per-tier/diameter-keyed font-size model, since a custom ratio no longer corresponds to any of the five named tiers.

s1's vega-spec-builder donutSummaryUtils.ts shares the identical placeholder formula/constants, but per project direction this work is s2-only - s1 is intentionally left unchanged, not a gap to track here.

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale: the existing '_summaryFontSizeScale' threshold scale and '_summaryFontSize' signal (packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts) need to be reworked to key directly off the donut's outer diameter against the five named size tiers, rather than off donutRadius*holeRatio*ratio - this is a redefinition of the existing scale's domain/range and formula, not an unrelated new one. requiresS1S2Parity is false: per project direction, this work is scoped to s2 only - packages/vega-spec-builder (s1) shares the identical placeholder formula today, but is intentionally left unchanged, not treated as a parity gap. Confirmed per the donut-chart-tokens skill (§5 Behavior tokens): hover/emphasize color changes apply to direct-label/advanced-label/benchmark-two-line values, not the plain center Metric total/label this spec covers - so touchesHoverAnimation and touchesLegendInteraction are correctly false here.

implementationPlan.change: Replace DONUT_SUMMARY_FONT_SIZE_RATIO/DONUT_SUMMARY_MIN_RADIUS with constants describing the five named size tiers directly: outer diameter breakpoints (60/120/160/200/400), the corresponding metric-total font sizes (18/20/22/36/50), and metric-label font sizes (12/14/16/20/24), decoupled from holeRatio.

Rework getDonutSummaryScales/getDonutSummarySignals to key font size off the donut's outer diameter (min(width,height)) against the new tier breakpoints instead of donutRadius*holeRatio*ratio. Recalibrate the existing fit-based visibility gate (currently the 45px inner-radius cutoff in getSummaryValueEncode/getSummaryLabelEncode) to the corrected fixed-ring-width model - keep it as a fallback for text that won't fit, not a per-tier design rule. Recompute the truncation 'limit' inputs from the corrected inner radius (outer radius minus the tier's fixed ring width) instead of the holeRatio-derived radius.

Add assertions pinning the exact rendered font size at each of the five named size tiers (60/120/160/200/400px diameter) plus a truncation case at each - current tests only assert scale/signal wiring and the symbolic formula shape, not real numeric output.
Add or confirm stories exercising all five named size tiers so the corrected per-tier sizing is visually verifiable in Storybook, following the existing 'Responsive' story's pattern.

openQuestions: Confirm the two 'derived' (computed, not individually measured) values before finalizing: XS metric-total 18px/metric-label 12px, and XL metric-total 50px/metric-label 24px - donut-chart-tokens explicitly flags these as needing confirmation in Figma.

Confirm the exact font-size interpolation behavior for a donut at a diameter between named tiers (e.g. the ~106px example used earlier, between XS=60 and S=120) - snap to the nearest tier's font size, or interpolate continuously?

Confirm how the existing public holeRatio prop should interact with the new fixed-ring-width-per-tier/diameter-keyed font-size model, since a user-supplied custom holeRatio no longer maps to any of the five named tiers.
